riskProg.calc.sub: Cells at 16 and above are outside the acceptance criteria.
riskProg.calc.note: Below 16 the risk is acceptable — monitoring is required but no written assessment. At 16 or above, controls must be established until the score is acceptable; any residual score still at 16 or above is recorded in the IT Risk Register with full details and follow-up actions.
